see your promotion."},{"question":"What information should I include on my restaurant coupon?","answer":"Effective restaurant coupons typically include: clear offer value (discount amount, free item, on-premise distribution for encouraging return visits or introducing new menu items to existing customers."},{"question":"Should I include an expiration date on my restaurant coupons?","answer":"Yes, more valuable and exclusive than open-ended promotions. The optimal validity period varies by promotion type, but 30-60 days is common for most restaurant offers."},{"question":"How quickly can I create professional restaurant coupons?","answer":"Most restaurants create their perfect promotion designs in under 15 minutes, including revisions.
